'''P'laang Ri''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Ri owed the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] a few favors, and Solo collected when he left his [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] in Ri's [[P'laang Ri's hangar|hangar]] on [[Siskeen/Legends|Siskeen]] for safekeeping. Solo and fellow smuggler [[Avik Lore]] then took Ri's [[Zeta-class long-range shuttle|''Zeta''-class shuttle]] ''[[Arkanoid]]'' and went on a mission to [[Zoma Station]] to steal a shipment.<ref name="renegade" />
